msg: Third-party Marketplace action: GitLab runners have no runtime for `uses:` actions.
fix: Rewrite the step as `script:` lines, or use a GitLab CI/CD Catalog component via `include: - component:`.

msg: actions/cache or actions/*-artifact step: GitLab has no step for this, it is a job keyword.
fix: Use the job keywords `cache:` (paths + key) and `artifacts:` (paths + expire_in); downstream jobs get artifacts through `needs:`.

msg: actions/setup-* toolchain step: GitLab jobs pick the toolchain through the container image.
fix: Set `image:` to the matching tag (for example `image: node:20` or `image: python:3.12`) and drop the step.

msg: Job calls a reusable workflow: GitLab has no `workflow_call` target.
fix: Move the shared jobs into a YAML file pulled in with `include:`, or run it as a child pipeline with `trigger: include:`.

msg: `on: schedule` cron: GitLab does not read schedules from .gitlab-ci.yml.
fix: Create a pipeline schedule under Build > Pipeline schedules (or the Pipeline schedules API) and gate jobs with `rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"`.

msg: `pull_request_target`: GitLab has no trigger that runs fork code with the target project's secrets.
fix: Fork merge request pipelines run in the fork by default; a maintainer can run one in the parent project from the merge request. Redesign the job around that.

msg: `workflow_run` trigger: GitLab pipelines cannot listen for another pipeline finishing.
fix: Chain the work inside one pipeline with `needs:`/stages, or start it from the upstream job with `trigger:` (multi-project or child pipeline).

msg: macOS runner: GitLab-hosted macOS runners are offered on Premium and Ultimate only.
fix: Budget GitLab Premium for this project, or register your own Mac as a self-managed runner and target it with `tags:`.

msg: Self-hosted runner label: GitHub runner registrations do not carry over.
fix: Install GitLab Runner on the same host, register it to the project or group, and replace the labels with `tags:`.

msg: Job deploys to a GitHub environment: if it has required reviewers, the GitLab equivalent (deployment approvals on a protected environment) is Premium and Ultimate only.
fix: Keep `environment: name:` (works on Free); add approvals only after the Premium decision, or replace the reviewer gate with a `when: manual` job.

msg: `permissions:` block: GitLab has no per-job token scope in the YAML.
fix: The job uses CI_JOB_TOKEN with its fixed scope; configure the job token allowlist in project settings, or use a project access token stored as a masked variable.

msg: GITHUB_TOKEN reference: this token does not exist on GitLab.
fix: Use $CI_JOB_TOKEN for registry/API calls it supports, or a project access token saved as a masked CI/CD variable.

msg: Repository secret: GitHub secrets cannot be exported and must be re-created.
fix: Re-enter the value as a masked (and, for deploys, protected) CI/CD variable and reference it as $NAME.

msg: `strategy.matrix.exclude`: GitLab `parallel:matrix` has no exclude key.
fix: Write the combinations you want as separate entries in the `parallel:matrix` list (one hash per kept combination).

msg: hashFiles() cache key: expressions are not evaluated by GitLab.
fix: Use `cache: key: files:` with at most two files (for example package-lock.json).

msg: Job `outputs:` map: GitLab jobs pass values through a dotenv report.
fix: Write KEY=value lines to a file and publish it with `artifacts: reports: dotenv:`; later jobs read $KEY after `needs:`.

msg: Writes to $GITHUB_OUTPUT/ENV/PATH/STEP_SUMMARY: these files are not set on GitLab.
fix: Export variables in the same `script:` or write a dotenv report; for a summary, publish an artifact.

msg: `${{ github.* }}` expression: GitLab does not evaluate GitHub contexts.
fix: Swap for predefined variables: github.sha -> $CI_COMMIT_SHA, github.ref_name -> $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME, github.repository -> $CI_PROJECT_PATH, github.actor -> $GITLAB_USER_LOGIN.

msg: `concurrency:` group: GitLab splits this into two features.
fix: Use `resource_group:` to serialise deploy jobs, and `interruptible: true` plus the auto-cancel setting to cancel superseded pipelines.

msg: `workflow_dispatch` manual trigger: GitLab starts manual pipelines from Build > Pipelines > Run pipeline.
fix: Declare the inputs as variables with defaults (or `spec: inputs:`) and gate jobs with `rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web"`.
